_howto: Copy this file to <slug>.json in this folder. The filename is the URL: relay-yard.json → /projects/relay-yard/.
Keep status: draft + contentStatus: placeholder while anything below is unfinished; the entry stays hidden.
Publish with status: published and contentStatus: verified only after the owner confirms every claim.
collection is the shelf: featured products first, then open-source, then professional case studies.
status: sample still renders a labelled demonstration, but no sample is published today.
Delete any key you do not need. Empty arrays are fine; a section with no content is not rendered.
Notes, receipts and pending questions belong in _notes, which the schema strips.
Persist drafts with the same filename prefix (draft-<slug>.json) so the build never publishes them.
title: Project name
summary: What hurts today, and what this does about it. One or two sentences; this is the lede on the case study and the card text everywhere else.
context: The operating problem: who does the work today, where the handoffs break, and what the inconsistency costs. Blank line = new paragraph.

solution.title: Capability or module
solution.body: What it does for the person using it.

contribution: First person and bounded: what you designed, built and decided, and what someone else owned.
approach: The sequence of decisions, starting from the first constraint. Name the simpler option you rejected and why.
aiRole: Delete this key when there is no model. Otherwise: what the model does, what it may never decide, and who confirms the result.

technicalDecisions.title: Decision title
technicalDecisions.body: What it solved, what it cost, and what would have broken without it.

outcomes: Verified result or lesson. Owner-supplied numbers only; qualitative is fine.

cover.alt: What the image actually shows, not a mood

screenshots.alt: Describe the screen and the state it shows
screenshots.caption: Optional: what the reader should notice.

confidentialityNote: What is withheld and why. Delete if nothing is withheld.
evidenceNote: What backs this page: repositories, deployments, READMEs, the CV. Rendered under Evidence.
_notes: Not rendered: what is still missing, who approved the screenshots, where each number came from.
